DIGITAL ROOT CONJECTURE TEST
==============================================================================

Conjecture:
  For every n > 2, the digital root of the maximum value in the Collatz orbit of n is always 7 or a multiple of 4, i.e. in {4, 7, 8} (OEIS A025586 comments, Guy Chouraqui, 2023).

BASE RUN: n = 3..200000
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Analysis time: 0.08s
Counterexamples found: 33115 / 199998
